nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/tree/main

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors/ & or
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_1.3_singularity_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the cyberpunk singer, shown in a reference sheet.

summary:
@image1 walks toward the camera across a burning orange desert without a care, singing to the lens, while the song builds.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, hot saturated grade, heavy VFX.
[Shot 1] Crane shot: the camera starts high above an endless orange desert at midday and Cranes down at fast speed to a low angle in front of @image1, then Tracks backward ahead of him as he walks straight toward the lens across the dunes at a steady pace, hands loose at his sides, jacket flapping in the hot wind, completely unbothered. The camera Pushes in slowly to a close-up of his face as he walks, holds there, then eases back out to a medium shot from the waist up. Thin blue motion graphics float in the air around his head, projected from the implants on his face: targeting brackets, scrolling lines and glitch bars, abstract shapes only, no readable text, flickering on every drum hit. On the heavy hits a ring of sand jumps off the dune crests around his boots and settles again. Heat haze ripples along the horizon behind him the whole time. @image1 (S1) sings the vocal lines of the song straight into the lens as they come; between lines his lips press closed and his face stays blank. The take ends on the medium shot in front of him, @image1 walking steadily toward the lens, the dunes stretching out behind him.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays over the whole clip. Under it, hot wind across the dunes, boots crunching in sand, and a soft hiss of sand on the drum hits.

non_diegetic_music:
Mid-tempo rock at 89 BPM: a tense, sparse intro of guitar and kick drum that builds and breaks into full distorted guitars and crashing drums right at the end.

subject_definitions:

summary:
A wall of jungle mist rolls across the desert behind @image1 and swallows everything, leaving him walking toward the camera through a rainforest where the rain freezes on the beat.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, heavy VFX, hot orange grade turning deep green.
[Shot 1] The take opens on the framing where the previous clip ends: a medium shot in front of @image1 as he walks toward the lens across the orange dunes, the camera Tracking backward ahead of him. Far behind him on the horizon a huge wall of dark green jungle mist rises and rolls across the dunes toward the camera, swallowing the desert as it comes. It stays one connected mass, nothing breaks off, and everything it has passed is jungle. It overtakes him, he walks on through it without looking back, and it rolls over the lens; when it thins he is walking toward the camera along a muddy path through a dense rainforest in heavy rain. The camera drops to a low angle, then Pushes in to a close-up of his face. On each heavy hit the rain stops in mid-air: every drop hangs suspended around his face, held still, then falls again. The motion graphics turn green, abstract shapes only, no readable text. @image1 (S1) sings the vocal lines of the song straight into the lens as they come; between lines his lips press closed and his face stays blank and unbothered, water running down it. The take ends on the close-up of his face as he walks toward the lens, rain hanging still around him.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays over the whole clip. Under it, desert wind and boots in sand, a deep rising rumble as the mist rolls in, then heavy rain on leaves and boots in mud to the end.

non_diegetic_music:
Rock at 89 BPM, full band: distorted guitars, heavy kick and snare, driving bass.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the cyberpunk singer, shown in a reference sheet.

summary:
The rainforest behind @image1 collapses into a rolling front of concrete dust that becomes an abandoned warehouse, the lights bursting above him on the beat while he sings straight to the camera.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, heavy VFX, deep green grade turning cold and grimy.
[Shot 1] The take opens on the framing where the previous clip ends: a close-up of @image1's face as he walks toward the lens through the rainforest in heavy rain, the camera Tracking backward ahead of him. The camera pulls back to a medium shot. Behind him the trees fold down and collapse into a rolling front of grey concrete dust that pours along the path toward the camera; it stays one connected body and nothing breaks off. It overtakes him, he walks on through it, it rolls over the lens, and when it settles he is walking toward the camera across a huge abandoned warehouse, black cables hanging from the broken roof, water dripping, a cracked concrete floor of puddles and broken glass. On each heavy hit a row of hanging fluorescent tubes above him bursts in a shower of sparks, one row after another, coming toward the camera. The camera Pushes in to a close-up of his face, then drops to a low angle in a medium shot. Thin blue motion graphics float around his head from the implants on his face, abstract brackets and glitch bars only, no readable text. @image1 (S1) sings the lead vocal of the song straight into the lens through the whole clip, mouth wide on the loud lines, jaw and lips clearly shaping every word; when the vocals pause his lips press closed and his face stays blank and unbothered. The take ends on the low medium shot in front of him, @image1 walking steadily toward the lens under the falling sparks.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays over the whole clip. Under it, heavy rain and mud, a deep grinding rumble as the forest collapses into dust, then dripping water, boots on wet concrete and glass tubes popping on the drum hits.

non_diegetic_music:
Rock at 89 BPM, full band with a raw male lead vocal over distorted guitars, heavy kick and snare hitting hard in a run of four, driving bass.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the cyberpunk singer, shown in a reference sheet.

summary:
The warehouse wall behind @image1 blows in on the beat and the blast leaves him walking down a warzone street, explosions freezing in mid-air around him.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, heavy VFX, cold grimy grade turning burnt orange and grey.
[Shot 1] The take opens on the framing where the previous clip ends: a wide low angle in front of @image1 as he walks toward the lens across the abandoned warehouse, sparks drifting down, the camera Tracking backward ahead of him. On a heavy drum hit the brick wall far behind him blows inward: bricks fly past him toward the camera and hang suspended in the air around him, held still, and a front of dust and fire rolls through the hole and across the floor toward the lens. He walks on through the hanging bricks without flinching. The dust rolls over the lens, and when it clears he is walking down a ruined city street at dusk, burnt-out tanks and cars on both sides, buildings on fire, tracer fire overhead. The camera Arcs around him at medium speed to behind him, showing the burning street stretching ahead, then keeps arcing back round to his front and Pushes in fast to an extreme close-up of the implants on his face, then pulls back to a medium shot. On each heavy hit an explosion bursts beside the street; its fireball and debris hang frozen in mid-air, held still, then rush on. Ash and embers drift the whole time. The motion graphics turn red, abstract targeting brackets only, no readable text. @image1 (S1) sings the vocal lines of the song straight into the lens as they come; between lines his lips press closed and his face stays blank and unbothered. The take ends on the medium shot in front of him, @image1 walking steadily toward the lens down the burning street.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays over the whole clip. Under it, boots on concrete, a deep blast as the wall blows in, then fire crackling, distant gunfire and explosions landing on the drum hits to the end.

non_diegetic_music:
Rock at 89 BPM, full band: distorted guitars, crashing drums, driving bass.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the cyberpunk singer, shown in a reference sheet.

summary:
Grey smoke rolls over @image1 on the warzone street and clears on him standing on the open ramp of a cargo plane high above the clouds, backing toward the edge while he sings to the camera.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, heavy VFX, burnt orange grade turning cold blue and golden sunset.
[Shot 1] The take opens on the framing where the previous clip ends: a medium shot in front of @image1 as he walks toward the lens down the burning warzone street, the camera Tracking backward ahead of him. A thick wall of grey smoke rolls down the street behind him, overtakes him and rolls over the lens. When it streams away he is standing on the open rear ramp of a military cargo plane high above the clouds at sunset, facing the camera, the golden sea of clouds and the sky right behind him. The camera is inside the hold looking out at him. He walks slowly backward toward the edge of the ramp, still facing the lens, hands loose at his sides, wind blasting his hair and jacket from behind. He wears no parachute and does not care. The camera Pushes in to a close-up of his face, then eases back to a medium shot. Thin blue motion graphics float around his head, abstract lines and brackets only, no readable text. @image1 (S1) sings the vocal lines of the song straight into the lens as they come; between lines his lips press closed and his face stays blank and unbothered. The take ends on the medium shot, @image1 standing one step from the edge of the ramp, facing the lens, the sunset clouds behind him.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays over the whole clip. Under it, fire and distant gunfire, a deep rushing roar as the smoke rolls over, then droning plane engines and wind howling across the open ramp to the end.

non_diegetic_music:
Rock at 89 BPM: a short quiet break, then the full band comes back with distorted guitars and crashing drums.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the cyberpunk singer, shown in a reference sheet.

summary:
On the last drum hit @image1 lets himself fall backward off the plane's ramp, still facing the camera, and drops away into the clouds.

detailed_description:
Big-budget rock music video, one continuous take with no cuts, anamorphic lens, golden sunset grade, heavy VFX.
[Shot 1] The take opens on the framing where the previous clip ends: a medium shot of @image1 standing at the edge of the cargo plane's open ramp, facing the lens, the golden sea of clouds behind him, wind blasting his hair and jacket. On the last heavy drum hit he spreads his arms and lets himself fall backward off the ramp, still facing the camera. The camera rushes forward to the edge and tilts down, holding on his face as he falls away below, arms spread, jacket flapping, getting smaller against the clouds until they swallow him. His motion graphics flare once and blink out. @image1 (S1) sings any last vocal line of the song before he falls; after it his lips press closed and stay closed to the end. The take ends on the empty sea of clouds lit by the sunset.

overall_soundscape:
The song plays to its end. Under it, droning engines and howling wind across the ramp, a rush of air as he falls, then only wind over the clouds.

non_diegetic_music:
Rock at 89 BPM: the song's final bars, a short drop-out and one last big hit on the full band.
